research_questions.question: What additional evidence does a region-aware, multi-metric evaluation framework provide beyond traditional image-similarity metrics when evaluating AI-assisted painting restoration?
research_questions.answer: Complementary region-aware metrics expose disagreements; no single or combined score establishes restoration trustworthiness.
research_questions.limitation: Metrics and feature similarity are not conservation approval.

research_questions.question: How do selected inpainting methods differ in restoration quality across controlled artificial damage conditions, and how consistent are these differences across the evaluated paintings?
research_questions.answer: LaMa leads 10 of 11 saved quality anchors and Telea leads crop SSIM. HINT is a full deterministic method; SDXL remains bounded. Conclusions apply to this controlled benchmark.
research_questions.limitation: No universal model superiority or independently established art-historical style effect.

research_questions.question: How can repeated-candidate disagreement be used to characterize the stability of stochastic painting restorations, and how does it relate to other restoration-quality diagnostics?
research_questions.answer: The 780 canonical and 245 damage-size groups characterize repeated-seed variation. Disagreement supports inspection, not calibrated confidence or historical correctness.
research_questions.limitation: Only supported repeated-seed groups; deterministic methods do not acquire seed uncertainty.

headline_findings.limitation: This does not represent every artistic tradition, period or conservation condition.
headline_findings.statement: The collection contains 300 paintings, with 60 in each of five broad visual categories.
headline_findings.title: Balanced controlled collection

headline_findings.limitation: Eligibility and metric performance do not establish historical correctness.
headline_findings.statement: The four full-scope methods were compared on 2,620 eligible cases, producing 10,480 primary candidates.
headline_findings.title: Matched four-method evidence

headline_findings.limitation: No combined or universal quality score was created.
headline_findings.statement: LaMa led 10 of 11 separate quality anchors; Telea led crop SSIM.
headline_findings.title: Different measurements can prefer different methods

headline_findings.limitation: This is empirical variation, not calibrated confidence.
headline_findings.statement: Stable Diffusion has 1,025 supported four-seed groups covering 4,100 candidate memberships.
headline_findings.title: Repeated outputs reveal variation

headline_findings.limitation: A flag is not a probability, expert verdict or conservation decision.
headline_findings.statement: Operational thresholds point to evidence that deserves closer inspection.
headline_findings.title: Flags organize review rather than replace it

headline_findings.limitation: Rendered lightness is not race or identity, and the audit does not establish demographic bias.
headline_findings.statement: D02 found hands harder to restore in its matched audit, while rendered lightness did not show a consistent overall association.
headline_findings.title: The focused portrait audit remains separate

statements: The package republishes validated evidence; it does not recompute metrics or restoration candidates.
The benchmark uses controlled synthetic damage and does not establish real-world conservation generality.
Visual plausibility is not historical correctness, restoration trustworthiness, or conservation approval.
Four methods have full coverage; SDXL has 24 completed candidates from a bounded 35-case schedule and is not a fifth full benchmark method.
D01 is separate 12-case HINT/MAT decision evidence; D02 is a separate focused portrait audit, not demographic-bias ground truth.
The N35 live deployment was accepted with 14 warning nonpasses and a disclosed notebook-source mismatch; unmeasured qualifications remain unmeasured.
The N29 historical artifact-manifest discrepancy is retained and disclosed, not silently repaired.
Repeated-seed variability is an uncertainty proxy, not calibrated confidence.
Computational flags, retrieval results, and recommendations are decision support, not expert ground truth.
No universal combined quality, uncertainty, or trustworthiness score is constructed.

n29.disposition: Disclose the historical metadata discrepancy; verify all six payload groups independently, never rewrite the upstream record.

n35.disposition: Owner accepted proceeding without rerun; preserve source mismatch and all unmeasured qualifications as limitations, not passes.
